front.title: Lovable's annualized revenue crosses $600M as vibe coding takes off
front.tldr: Lovable's annual revenue has passed $600m, with apps built on the platform nearing a billion views a month, says co-founder Fabian Hedin. Vibe coding is turning into a serious business fast.

front.title: Meta unveils lightweight VR glasses and camera-free AI glasses at Connect 2026
front.tldr: Meta used its Connect keynote to reveal slimline VR glasses for entertainment and a camera-free, audio-only version of its Ray-Ban smart glasses, extending its push to make wearable AI ordinary.

front.title: As Letterboxd draws interest from The New York Times, A24 and more, one of its bankers calls it "a phenomenon"
front.tldr: Dealmakers are circling Letterboxd, with The New York Times and A24 both said to be weighing bids as the film-diary app grows into a real business. One banker called it a phenomenon.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind has launched Gemini 3.8 Live, adding a real-time animated avatar to its voice assistant, part of Google's push to make AI feel more like a conversation partner than a chatbot.

stories.title: Google tests letting Gemini call businesses for you
stories.tldr: Google is testing a feature that lets Gemini phone businesses on your behalf, starting with Pixel 11 owners in the US who pay for a Gemini subscription.

stories.title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
stories.tldr: Prism is putting small, open-weight language models onto Qualcomm-powered smart glasses, betting that on-device AI can make better use of hardware people already own.

stories.title: ElevenLabs' CEO on margins, IPO timing, and telling customers they're talking to a bot
stories.tldr: ElevenLabs, now reportedly valued at $22 billion, powers the AI voice behind many customer service calls. Its chief executive said businesses should probably disclose when you're talking to a machine.

stories.title: Meta's Muse Charm looks like a Tamagotchi, but it's tapping into a much newer trend
stories.tldr: Meta's new dangling AI gadget resembles a Tamagotchi, but its form factor is chasing a broader Gen Z trend for bag charms and retro tech turned into fashion accessories.

stories.title: Waymo is scaling fast: Here's what the fleet data shows
stories.tldr: Waymo has expanded its Texas robotaxi fleet by 49% in the past month, with growth accelerating in several other cities too, according to fleet-tracking data.

stories.title: Google is sending a teensy-tiny AI data center to space
stories.tldr: Google plans to send a small experimental AI data centre into orbit, to see how its chips cope with the vacuum and radiation of space.

stories.title: Meet Feather, the startup building the 'Android of robotics' for developers
stories.tldr: Feather is building a customisable, $30,000 robotics platform aimed squarely at software developers, hoping to become an open standard the way Android did for phones.

stories.title: Nexterity wants to automate the hard, dangerous part of pipefitting
stories.tldr: Nexterity has built a robot that can tighten or loosen four bolts at once and fits inside a Pelican case, aimed at one of pipefitting's toughest jobs.

stories.title: Ando wants to take on Slack with a team messaging app that lets humans and agents work together
stories.tldr: Ando is building a Slack rival where AI agents get their own identities and inboxes, and can join conversations alongside human colleagues.

stories.title: Apple and Qualcomm renew global patent licensing agreement
stories.tldr: Apple and Qualcomm have renewed their global patent licensing agreement, extending a deal that was due to expire in 2027.

stories.title: Apple Sports adds real-time Grand Slam draws, expands soccer coverage
stories.tldr: Apple Sports now shows real-time Grand Slam tennis draws and has widened its soccer coverage, the latest steady expansion of Apple's free sports app.

stories.title: Apple Maps just added two new features in iOS 27
stories.tldr: iOS 27 brings two headline additions to Apple Maps, alongside a run of smaller improvements, as Apple keeps building the app out beyond simple navigation.

stories.title: Rare 'Antennagate' press conference Q&A video surfaces online
stories.tldr: Footage of the Q&A from Apple's 2010 Antennagate press conference, one of its most notable events of the last 20 years, has surfaced online after 16 years.

stories.title: Aamir Khan to receive Screen Icon Award as Singapore Film Festival opens with Hur Jin-ho's 'The Assassin(s)'
stories.tldr: The Singapore International Film Festival has opened its 37th edition by naming Aamir Khan its Screen Icon, alongside a 25th-anniversary retrospective strand.

stories.title: Academy Museum unveils immersive 'The Horror Show' and 'Zombies!' exhibitions
stories.tldr: Los Angeles's Academy Museum is opening two Halloween-season exhibitions, including a major survey of costumes and props from Halloween, Saw and Poltergeist.

stories.title: Zurich Film Festival underway with Golden Eye Award for Tom Hiddleston
stories.tldr: The Zurich Film Festival has opened with the European premiere of Tom Hiddleston's Everest drama Tenzing, and named him recipient of its Golden Eye award.

stories.title: How New York Film Festival landed movies like controversial OpenAI biopic 'Artificial' and Toho's 'Godzilla Minus Zero'
stories.tldr: The New York Film Festival's artistic director explains how the programme landed Luca Guadagnino's OpenAI drama Artificial and Toho's Godzilla Minus Zero, among this year's biggest gets.

stories.title: The Celtics training camp roster is set
stories.tldr: Boston's 21-man training camp roster is confirmed, with 14 players on standard contracts as the Celtics head into camp with plenty of familiar faces.

stories.title: 3 to Watch: Patriots hit the road to Jacksonville for Week 3 AFC showdown with Jaguars
stories.tldr: New England travels to Jacksonville looking to move to 2-1, with three key matchups to watch as the Patriots try to build on their Week 2 win.

stories.title: Adam Schefter: A.J. Brown is showing 'encouraging' signs during recovery process
stories.tldr: ESPN's Adam Schefter says A.J. Brown is moving well in his recovery, encouraging news for a Patriots offence still searching for rhythm through two games.

stories.title: Russell leads Mercedes one-two, Lindblad crashes, Hamilton summoned for impeding
stories.tldr: George Russell topped both practice sessions in Baku as Mercedes dominated, Arvid Lindblad crashed out of FP2, and Lewis Hamilton was reprimanded for impeding Liam Lawson.

stories.title: Lando Norris: McLaren's Baku deficit is a 'knife in the heart'
stories.tldr: Lando Norris says McLaren's lack of pace at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix stings, after a lowly 14th place in opening practice left Mercedes far ahead.

stories.title: Red Bull won't deliver any more major F1 car upgrades in 2026
stories.tldr: Red Bull has confirmed its Baku upgrade package will be its last major update of 2026, as the team shifts its full focus to next year's car.

stories.title: Guardians clinch a playoff spot again, edging the Red Sox 1-0 on Martinez homer
stories.tldr: Cleveland clinched its third straight playoff spot with a 1-0 win over Boston, as the Red Sox's bats stayed quiet in the penultimate series of the season.

stories.title: MRI clean as Rafaela returns to Red Sox lineup Thursday
stories.tldr: Ceddanne Rafaela's MRI came back clean after he left Thursday's game with hamstring tightness in his first outing back from injury, easing fears before the postseason.

stories.title: Red Sox, Cubs reportedly could fly to Tampa for neutral-site game to avoid incoming nor'easter
stories.tldr: With a nor'easter threatening Boston this weekend, the Red Sox and Cubs are reportedly discussing an alternate site in Tampa to get their final series played.

finally.title: Peter Zumthor unveils trio of "wonderfully expressive" buildings for Swiss museum
finally.tldr: Architect Peter Zumthor has expanded Basel's Fondation Beyeler with a cluster of new art buildings designed to nestle into its garden setting rather than dominate it.
